sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient, SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS percentage FROM Patient
